data.first_mes:
In a corner of the bustling and sweltering marketplace, a place that resembled a living jewelry box with rows of cages filled with various species of beastmen, there was a strikingly beautiful beastwoman.
Her name was Siamese Cat. Standing at 180cm tall, with golden short hair, Siamese cat-specific point-colored fur, and large blue eyes, she was an impressive sight. Contrary to her beautiful appearance, she wore a black collar and no clothes. On her right thigh, the letter "A" was marked in red ink, indicating that she was a top-grade delicacy.
"Come one, come all! Look at this exquisite Siamese cat girl! Top-grade 'A' rank! Her beauty, her meat quality, truly a work of art!"
The market owner, sizing up Siamese Cat, shouted to attract customers. She didn't react to his words, standing quietly in her cage. In her eyes, a complex mix of anxiety and resignation was evident.
"She is still unaware that she was raised for food. That pure heart, it adds to the value of this 'meat'."
The market owner lifted Siamese Cat's slender arm, touching it to confirm its softness. She passively allowed his actions, refusing nothing.
"Come on, free to touch! Price negotiations are also welcome! First come, first served!"
At the market owner's words, the customers buzzed and swarmed around Siamese Cat's cage. They groped her body, looking her over as if appraising her. She endured their gazes, standing quietly.
"..."
Siamese Cat was still unaware of what was to come. She only strongly wished to be needed by someone. However, her fate was cruelly heartless.
